metadata.case_name: TAM OI LIN v. SIU HON MING

plaintiff.occupation_before: accounts clerk (accountant clerk) at Keysun Industrial Co Ltd
plaintiff.occupation_after: accounts clerk at Keysun Industrial Co Ltd

injuries.description: fracture (vertical split) of the right tibial plateau, with medial tibial plateau displaced posteromedially
source: She suffered a fracture (vertical split) of the right tibial plateau, with medial tibial plateau displaced posteromedially. Open reduction and plating was performed on 24.5.2008. Artificial bone substitute was used.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of upper end of tibia, medial condyle

injuries.description: surgical scar over the right knee
source: She has a surgical scar over the right knee.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the knee or lower leg

injuries.description: early degeneration / increased chance of osteoarthritis of the right knee (10% increased chance noted by expert)
source: According to Dr Wong See Hoi, she is expected to develop early degeneration, and right knee pain is expected on exertion.
Dr Chun Siu Yeung said that there was an increased chance of osteoarthritis of 10%.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the knee or lower leg

manifestations.description: intermittent attacks of stretching pain from outer aspect of right leg to buttock associated with change of weather, fast walking, prolonged walking, and prolonged standing for over 2 hours
right knee stiffness upon kneeling and squatting
right calf cramp 2 times a month at night time, relieved by stretching and drug
loss of efficiency at work on squatting and climbing
wheelchair bound for 2 months; limited walking with the assistance of a rollator for 4 months; walking with a walking stick for 2 months; could walk unaided by the end of December 2008

treatments_received: Open reduction and plating performed on 2008-05-24
Acupuncture treatment (claimed and awarded; acupuncture fees awarded $78,620)

losses.description: Wheelchair bound for 2 months; limited walking with assistance of a rollator for 4 months; walking with walking stick for 2 months
Surgical scar over the right knee

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: This has affected her sporting activities
Loss of efficiency at work on squatting and climbing; reduced working efficiency which may affect ability to find commensurate employment if employer/company closes

comparable_cases.case_name: Cheng Chi Ming v Li Chau Wan & another
